headline: Quarterly growth was uneven, with a few firms posting strong top‑line expansion while others slowed.
summary: Coforge led the pack with 53.6% revenue growth and raised its EBIT margin guidance. HCLTech delivered double‑digit growth and a 21% profit jump, driven by AI revenue. Infosys trimmed its FY27 revenue outlook to 1‑2% and posted only 1.5% YoY growth, the slowest among the majors. Several companies highlighted AI contributions, but specific AI revenue figures were limited.

themes.title: AI‑driven revenue
themes.detail: Multiple firms cited AI as a key growth driver, with Infosys reporting 29% AI revenue growth and HCLTech’s AI revenue reaching $219 m.

themes.title: Margin pressure and guidance cuts
themes.detail: Infosys cut its FY27 revenue guidance, and Wipro signaled flat‑to‑slight decline in constant‑currency revenue for the next quarter.
